info.name: MentorConnect Edge API - frontend features
info.description:
# MentorConnect Edge API - frontend features

Tests what was added for the frontend handoff: LKR, 60 minute slots, slot overlap, public mentor pages, search filters, extended profiles, booking names, chat `with`, saved mentors, goals, reports and admin stats.

## Before you run
1. Reset and migrate the local database: `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .wrangler\state` then `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply mentorconnect-db --local`.
2. Start the Worker: `npm run dev` (http://127.0.0.1:8787).
3. Paste one Asgardeo access token per user into the collection variables: `adminToken`, `mentorToken`, `studentToken`, `outsiderToken`. The admin must be the user in `migrations/0002_seed.sql`, the others must not be registered yet.

## How to run
Run from top to bottom with the Collection Runner. Ids are saved into collection variables, so do not run single requests out of order. Section A uploads a small document to the R2 dev bucket.

## Notes
A successful review needs a COMPLETED session, which needs the slot start time to pass, so only the 400 and 409 cases are here.
